# Hi, I'm [Roberta Colapietro]{.name-highlight}!
<!--Short paragraph to explain the key message-->
A [PhD student]{.role} in chronobiology, I study how our body's internal clock works and how it gets broken in disease. As a [medical doctor]{.role}, I hope to one day turn these findings into real improvements for patients. In the meantime, as a [science communicator]{.role}, I strive to make the science of our internal clock accessible to everyone, with a dash of color and a pinch of fun.
